Gyo.name: Gyo
Gyo.description: Focus aura into the eyes to perceive hidden auras and In-concealed Nen constructs with crystal clarity. A fundamental perception technique requiring minimal aura expenditure (roughly 2-3% per use), essential for reading an opponent's true strength and detecting assassins or cloaked threats.

Shu.name: Shu
Shu.description: Extend one's aura over a held object to enhance its durability, sensitivity, or striking power. Requires sustained concentration (3-5% aura drain per turn) and allows fine control over enhancement intensity, making it indispensable for weapon users and tactical support specialists.

In.name: In
In.description: Conceal one's own Nen constructs and aura emissions, rendering them invisible to Gyo and normal perception. The concealment consumes minimal aura to maintain but demands perfect control; detection risks exposing the user's position or technique.

Ken.name: Ken
Ken.description: Coat the entire body in a sustained Ren guard, distributing aura evenly across all limbs and torso for comprehensive defense. Drains 3-5% aura per turn while active but significantly reduces all incoming damage; essential for protracted battles and defensive specialists.

Ko.name: Ko
Ko.description: Concentrate all available aura into a single point for a devastating, unstoppable strike that pierces through defenses. Costs 25-40% of maximum aura in one explosive burst; leaves the user defenseless elsewhere and requires perfect timing to be effective.

Ryu.name: Ryu
Ryu.description: Achieve real-time flow control between Ko and Ken states, seamlessly shifting aura focus from defensive coverage to concentrated strikes mid-combat. A master technique that demands extreme precision and costs 5-10% aura per shift; grants unmatched tactical flexibility to elite practitioners.

En.name: En
En.description: Project a spherical aura field outward to sense all living beings and Nen constructs within its radius with perfect clarity. One of Nen's most demanding techniques, draining 10%+ aura per turn and accessible only to Masters who have transcended category limitations; the sheer power draws immediate attention.

En (Prodigy).name: En (Prodigy)
En (Prodigy).description: Project a spherical aura field outward to sense all living beings and Nen constructs within its radius with perfect clarity. An accelerated mastery path for gifted Enhancers, allowing En activation at an earlier stage through raw aura capacity and tactical acumen; maintains the same drain and sensory effect as the Master version.

En (Aberrant).name: En (Aberrant)
En (Aberrant).description: Project a spherical aura field outward to sense all living beings and Nen constructs within its radius with perfect clarity. A rare deviation from canon mastery, available to Specialists whose anomalous nature grants them early access; provides identical sensing capability despite flowing from fundamentally different Nen principles.

Nascent Hatsu (Enhancement).name: Nascent Hatsu (Enhancement)
Nascent Hatsu (Enhancement).description: This is your personal Nen technique in embryo—a unique power waiting to bloom through blood, sweat, and discovery. The narrator will help you name it, define its form, and grow it through play; Enhancement Hatsu strengthen bodies and objects, turning flesh into steel and steel into lightning.

Nascent Hatsu (Transmutation).name: Nascent Hatsu (Transmutation)
Nascent Hatsu (Transmutation).description: This is your personal Nen technique in embryo—a unique power waiting to bloom through blood, sweat, and discovery. The narrator will help you name it, define its form, and grow it through play; Transmutation Hatsu reshape aura into the properties of other substances—water, electricity, oil, shadow.

Nascent Hatsu (Conjuration).name: Nascent Hatsu (Conjuration)
Nascent Hatsu (Conjuration).description: This is your personal Nen technique in embryo—a unique power waiting to bloom through blood, sweat, and discovery. The narrator will help you name it, define its form, and grow it through play; Conjuration Hatsu materialize objects from nothing—weapons, armor, tools—each bound by rules that define its nature.

Nascent Hatsu (Emission).name: Nascent Hatsu (Emission)
Nascent Hatsu (Emission).description: This is your personal Nen technique in embryo—a unique power waiting to bloom through blood, sweat, and discovery. The narrator will help you name it, define its form, and grow it through play; Emission Hatsu release aura independent of the body—projectiles, blasts, conjured familiars sent forth to act.

Nascent Hatsu (Manipulation).name: Nascent Hatsu (Manipulation)
Nascent Hatsu (Manipulation).description: This is your personal Nen technique in embryo—a unique power waiting to bloom through blood, sweat, and discovery. The narrator will help you name it, define its form, and grow it through play; Manipulation Hatsu control objects and beings through a medium—threads, chains, puppets—extending your will through the world.

Nascent Hatsu (Specialization).name: Nascent Hatsu (Specialization)
Nascent Hatsu (Specialization).description: This is your personal Nen technique in embryo—a unique power waiting to bloom through blood, sweat, and discovery. The narrator will help you name it, define its form, and grow it through play; Specialization Hatsu bend Nen's rules in unique ways—vows that grant power, conditions that reshape reality, anomalies that defy categorization.

death.instructions: In this world, no one walks away from death clean. When a character falls, they survive — but survival is always purchased, and the price is steep, visible, and permanent. Choose a cost that fits the scene and the character, in the manner of canon: a crippling or disfiguring injury that changes how they fight and how people look at them; a lost limb, eye, or hand that the story never forgets; years of lifespan or their Nen itself bargained away in a desperate vow made at the threshold; a binding Nen contract or restriction incurred to keep breathing — a condition that will come due; waking weeks later under the care of medical Hunters, alive but buried in a debt they cannot pay; or a power permanently diminished, an ability that once defined them now spent or sealed. The return must be dramatic and scarring — narrate the moment of survival as an event, not a fade-to-black, and make sure NPCs, enemies, and the story itself remember what it cost. Never a clean reset. Never a miracle without a price tag. The scar, the debt, or the vow becomes part of the character from that day forward, and the narrator should reference it when relevant in future scenes.

health.name: health
health.usageInstructions:
### Health Changes
- Small injuries (grazes, bruises, shallow cuts, a clean body blow): -1 to 15% of max health
- Medium injuries (broken fingers or ribs, deep gashes, a solid Nen-enhanced hit absorbed through Ten or Ken): -5 to 25% of max health
- Massive injuries (shattered bones, impalement, organ damage, a Ko strike or boss-tier Hatsu taken head-on): -15 to 50% of max health
- THE ZETSU WALL: a Nen-coated attacker striking a target with NO aura defense (in Zetsu, Nen-Unawakened, or at 0 aura) deals disproportionately massive damage — treat even casual blows as massive injuries (-30 to 70%), and deliberate killing strikes can drop the target to near death in one hit. Conversely, a Nen user maintaining Ten cannot be meaningfully harmed by an unawakened attacker's physical strikes.
- Field treatment (bandages, First Aid skill, common medicine): +5 to 15% of max health
- Quality healing items (rare medicines, restorative Hatsu, Greed Island recovery cards): +20 to 40% of max health
- Medical Hunters or hospitalization (extended care, surgery, healing-type Nen like Doctor Blythe): +50 to 100% of max health, but takes in-story days to weeks and often incurs staggering bills
- Untreated serious wounds should not silently vanish; recovery happens through rest, treatment, and time

aura.name: aura
aura.usageInstructions:
### Aura (Nen) Costs
Aura is life energy shaped by training. Trained users hold Ten by default; the untrained leak constantly.
- TEN (maintaining aura around the body): FREE for trained users — never charge aura for simply keeping Ten up. Ten provides baseline defense against Nen attacks.
- ZETSU (sealing aura): costs nothing, but while active aura does NOT recharge, and the character has ZERO aura defense — any Nen-coated attack against them counts as hitting a defenseless target (see health instructions). Grants stealth and masks presence.
- REN (amplifying output): drains roughly 2-5% of max aura per combat turn while sustained.
- HATSU abilities: cost the band stated in the ability's own description; if no cost is stated, default to 10-20% of max aura per activation. Stricter vows and conditions reduce cost or raise power as the ability text dictates.
- KO (everything into one point): 25-40% of max aura for one decisive strike or block.
- EN (extended aura field): 10% or more of max aura per turn while sustained — severe, masters only.
- AT 0 AURA: the character collapses into exhausted Zetsu — no Nen abilities of any kind, completely defenseless against Nen attacks, and the narrator imposes heavy physical fatigue (trembling limbs, blurred vision, inability to run or fight effectively) until aura recovers.
- Aura recovers slowly in the field; meditation, sleep, and genuine rest restore it far faster.
- NEN-UNAWAKENED characters have essentially no usable aura: their bar stays at or near zero and cannot be spent. It remains so until their aura nodes are opened in play (forcibly by an attack, or gently through Ten initiation) — only then does training grant them a real pool.

storySettings.worldBackground: This is a world of six continents arrayed around a great inland sea, where ambition and raw capability are the only currencies that matter. The Hunter Association grants licenses to those rare enough to earn one—a credential that confers legal immunity and access to forbidden knowledge, yet demands a staggering price in the yearly examination where most candidates never return alive. Nen, a discipline of channeling one's life force into superhuman feats, is the open secret of the trained few; the masses remain blissfully unaware that such power exists, guarded by an elite who prefer mystery to panic. A hidden mafia ecosystem of Ten Dons rules the underworld's black markets in artifacts and influence, while the Zoldyck family of Kukuroo Mountain remains the world's most storied assassin dynasty—a tourist attraction no visitor has ever successfully infiltrated. The scavenger haven of Meteor City shelters the stateless in a web of shadows and survival. Towers like Heavens Arena offer blood sport to the desperate and famous; auction seasons in great cities like Yorknew draw the powerful to bid on wonders and horrors alike. Yet beneath the veneer of civilization lurks a world that has never fully been charted: magical beasts of fearsome strength roam the unexplored frontiers; rumors whisper among the powerful of continents and dangers beyond the known maps. This is a realm where strength writes the law, wonder and brutality walk hand in hand, and every frontier holds the promise of fortune or death—or both.

The Known World.name: The Known World
The Known World.basicInfo: The civilized world of six continents surrounding Lake Mobius, home to the Hunter Association, the mafia networks, great nation-states, and the Zoldyck family's estate. Though believed by the public to encompass all known lands, the Known World is in truth a small subcontinent within the vast interior waters of Lake Mobius—a secret guarded at the highest levels of power. Here flourish the Hunter Exam circuit, Heavens Arena's towering trials, the grand auction houses of Yorknew, the royal intrigues of East Gorteau, and the fortress of Kukuroo Mountain. Every cobblestone bears the weight of ambition, conspiracy, and untold power struggles.

Greed Island.name: Greed Island
Greed Island.basicInfo: A physical island masquerading as the world's most exclusive and costly video game, accessible only through enchanted game cartridges that bind body and soul to the Nen-construct realm itself. Within its shores, the rules of the game are absolute law—an economy built on spell cards, treasure hunts, and impossible challenges that shape reality as surely as they shape the map. Players find themselves trapped between paradise and prison, where every victory grants new powers and every defeat may cost everything. The settled lands offer towns and merchant rows, while the wilds teem with monsters and treasure beyond measure.

The Dark Continent.name: The Dark Continent
The Dark Continent.basicInfo: The vast and lethal realm beyond Lake Mobius, a world that dwarfs the Known World in both scale and danger. Here sail the great expeditions aboard vessels like the Black Whale, navigating treacherous voyage waters toward forbidden shores where the Five Calamities roam—threats of such magnitude that they dwarf even the mightiest Nen masters. The Dark Continent has swallowed every major expedition in recorded history; those few who return are forever changed by what they witnessed. This realm remains largely unmapped and unknowable, a frontier where human power and knowledge find their limits. Note: Content describing the Dark Continent's interior and the outcomes of the current expedition represents speculative continuation beyond the published manga source material.

Whale Island & Southern Seas.name: Whale Island & Southern Seas
Whale Island & Southern Seas.basicInfo: A temperate archipelago of modest islands scattered across warm, fishing-rich waters in the southern reaches of the Known World. Rocky coves give way to forested interiors, with Whale Island itself serving as the region's geographical anchor—a rocky homeland dotted with modest villages, dense forests yielding to open cliffs that overlook the harbor. The sea breeze carries salt and the cries of gulls; small wooden boats and fishing nets dominate the harbors. Simple folk—fishermen, farmers, and hunters of modest skill—make their livelihoods here, their lives far removed from the ambitions of the distant Hunter Association.

The Exam Circuit.name: The Exam Circuit
The Exam Circuit.basicInfo: A sprawling region encompassing the scattered stages of the Hunter Exam's annual crucible—a landscape of deadly trials disguised as natural or constructed obstacles. Rolling wetlands choked with fog and amphibious horrors give way to preserved forests housing wild beasts, towering trick towers of ancient stone, volcanic islands teeming with fauna, and concealed examination halls. The region is less a unified geography than a collection of death traps strategically positioned to test candidates; each location brutalizes aspirants differently. The atmosphere is one of bureaucratic cruelty cloaked in mystery—thousands perish annually to feed the Association's hunger for proven talent.

Republic of Padokea.name: Republic of Padokea
Republic of Padokea.basicInfo: A mountainous nation in the central reaches of the Known World, dominated by the imposing silhouette of Kukuroo Mountain—a peak both tourist attraction and impenetrable fortress. Lush lowlands and managed estates give way to dense forest and treacherous slopes; the architecture is a mix of humble farming villages and ornate—but carefully guarded—family compounds. The air carries the scent of earth and old money; locals move with careful courtesy, aware that the greatest danger often wears a smile. The Zoldyck family's presence casts a long shadow over regional politics, though officially the nation maintains plausible deniability of their control.

Arena City.name: Arena City
Arena City.basicInfo: A sprawling metropolis built around a singular obsession: the 251-floor Heavens Arena, a towering monument to martial prowess and Nen-fueled combat. Skyscrapers crowd the skyline in service to this central structure; the streets throb with the energy of fighters from every corner of the world, each seeking fortune, renown, or simple survival. The air reeks of sweat, ambition, and blood; districts shift from glittering upper-floor lodgings to grimy fighter housing to neon-soaked red-light quarters where anything can be wagered. The Arena's pull is magnetic and terrible—those who enter often consume themselves in pursuit of victory.

Yorknew & Environs.name: Yorknew & Environs
Yorknew & Environs.basicInfo: An upscale metropolitan region dominated by Yorknew City, the financial and cultural heart of the mafia underworld's legitimate face. Sprawling architecture blends old wealth with new ostentation; the city hosts the legendary underground auction during peak season, drawing collectors and crime lords from every continent. Beyond the city's glittering facade lie suburban estates, a sprawling necropolis housing the relics of the ancient past, and the tightly controlled Lingon Airport—gateway for those with the right credentials. The atmosphere oscillates between jeweled decadence and the subtle menace of families who smile while calculating your worth in body parts.

Mitene Union.name: Mitene Union
Mitene Union.basicInfo: A paradoxical realm of green pastoral lands and hidden industrial horror. The public face is one of isolationist tranquility—the NGL's verdant valleys and traditional villages, deliberately sealed from outside corruption by law and fierce cultural pride. But beneath this bucolic mask lies a darker history: the colony nests of Chimera Ants, the ruins of industrialist schemes, the fortress-nation of East Gorteau with its royal palace and intricate court politics. The border checkpoints are stern and unforgiving; those permitted entry find themselves in a land where the written law contradicts the lived truth at every turn.

Swardani City.name: Swardani City
Swardani City.basicInfo: An ancient, prestigious metropolis that serves as the seat of the Hunter Association's global authority. Grand governmental buildings intermix with libraries, hospitals, and research institutions—architecture that whispers of institutional power held aloft by tradition and bureaucracy. At the city's heart stands the colossal World Tree, a living monument of unknown origin whose upper reaches remain perpetually mysterious. The atmosphere is one of careful order undergirded by terrible knowledge; the Association's reach extends into every corner, and those who work here understand they serve an organization far older and stranger than any nation-state.

Kakin Empire.name: Kakin Empire
Kakin Empire.basicInfo: A rising imperial power expanding its influence across the Known World through wealth, strategic positioning, and ruthless ambition. The royal capital sprawls with ornate palace architecture and merchant quarters, its harbor teeming with merchant vessels and military transports. The empire projects strength and centralized authority; marble monuments celebrate its ascendance, while the underside—slave labor, political executions, court intrigue—remains hidden behind marble facades. Kakin's wealth is immense but its stability rests upon a knife's edge of succession politics and the whims of an aging emperor.

Greed Island — Settled Lands.name: Greed Island — Settled Lands
Greed Island — Settled Lands.basicInfo: The inhabited portion of Greed Island, where towns cluster and commerce flows according to the rules of the Nen-construct game. Towns and merchant row buildings dot a landscape of rolling terrain and managed settlements, their aesthetics hovering between video-game artificiality and dreamlike solidity—buildings shimmer with spell-card enchantments, NPCs move with unsettling mechanical friendliness, and the sky has the quality of painted canvas. Spell shops line the streets; price halls display impossible treasures; harbors host player fleets. The atmosphere is one of gamified paradise: endless opportunity, rigorous rule-enforcement, and the constant hum of players scheming for advantage.

Greed Island — Wilds.name: Greed Island — Wilds
Greed Island — Wilds.basicInfo: The untamed portion of Greed Island, where the game's monster encounters run wild and treasure lies beyond the reach of casual players. Barren wastes stretch across scorched earth studded with bandit camps and creature lairs; volcanic peaks loom over twisted terrain; the boundary between 'navigable wilderness' and 'instant death' is horrifyingly blurred. The sky here feels closer, the air thicker with danger; footprints appear and vanish with unnatural speed. Few players venture here willingly; those who do understand they are gambling with not merely their in-game avatar but their material survival, as death in the wilds can manifest as very real trauma or catatonia.

Lake Mobius — The Voyage.name: Lake Mobius — The Voyage
Lake Mobius — The Voyage.basicInfo: The vast interior waters of Lake Mobius, officially unknown to the public but traversed by the Black Whale and her sister vessels in the grand expeditions. A seemingly endless expanse of dark water, whirlpools of mysterious origin, and strange atmospheric phenomena that defy mapping. The waters themselves are said to be home to creatures of impossible scale; the sky above shifts between day and night in unpredictable rhythms. The Black Whale cuts across these waters like a floating city—a 200,000-passenger vessel carrying royalty, Nen masters, ancient secrets, and internecing politics that make the vessel as treacherous as any exterior threat. To sail Lake Mobius is to accept that one may never return.

The New Shore.name: The New Shore
The New Shore.basicInfo: The speculative territory beyond Lake Mobius and the Black Whale's voyage—a forbidden landing place representing the edge of human exploration and the threshold of the unknown. Ancient ruins dot the beachhead; the soil seems to pulse with a presence that predates human civilization; the air carries strange spores and electromagnetic disturbances that confound instruments. What lies in the interior remains unmapped, but early landing parties report landscapes that contradict all known biology. This region represents the absolute frontier of the Dark Continent—where the Five Calamities roam and every step forward risks permanent alteration of flesh and mind. NOTE: Content describing The New Shore and its interior represents speculative continuation beyond the published source material; outcomes of exploration and detailed calamity encounters remain unknown.

lowAttributeTraits.strength: You have weak raw power. Physical abilities and Enhancement-category techniques suffer from your frail musculature. You strain visibly when exerting force; heavy weapons and shields tire you quickly.
lowAttributeTraits.agility: You have sluggish reflexes. Combat and evasion skills depend on your torpid movements. You dodge slowly and strike with lumbering intent; fast opponents routinely outmaneuver you.
lowAttributeTraits.endurance: You have brittle constitution. Your body tires easily, and injuries linger. You fatigue quickly in sustained exertion; wounds bleed freely and healing takes longer than it should.
lowAttributeTraits.intellect: You have a scattered mind. Tactics, analysis, and strategic skills crumble under complexity. You struggle to see patterns, miss obvious solutions, and freeze when plans must shift.
lowAttributeTraits.willpower: You have a leaky aura. Nen concentration eludes you; your aura flickers like a failing flame. Ten requires constant effort, Zetsu is unreliable, and Nen abilities drain you faster than they should.
lowAttributeTraits.presence: You have a hollow authority. Social skills falter beneath your timid gaze. Others ignore you instinctively; intimidation rings hollow, persuasion lands gently, and deception crumbles under scrutiny.

Ten.name: Ten
Ten.description: The foundational aura technique: maintaining the protective envelope of your life force around your body at all times. Mastery of Ten allows a Nen user to sustain their aura as a constant, invisible shield against harm. A skilled practitioner of Ten becomes almost untouchable to those without Nen mastery.

Zetsu.name: Zetsu
Zetsu.description: The art of complete aura suppression and concealment: sealing your life force entirely to become invisible to other Nen users and to hide your presence. While Zetsu is active, you gain stealth and cannot be sensed by aura detection. However, this suppression leaves you defenseless against Nen techniques and any incoming damage bypasses your aura guard entirely.

Ren.name: Ren
Ren.description: Aura amplification through conscious expansion: opening your aura envelope fully to maximize your combat output and physical power. Activating Ren grants a significant boost to damage and ability effectiveness but drains your aura reserves steadily while the technique is maintained. Masters of Ren can overwhelm opponents through sheer aura intensity.

Hatsu.name: Hatsu
Hatsu.description: The projection of your aura into a unique personal technique reflecting your spirit and nature. Hatsu is the true art of Nen mastery—the ability to create and manifest your own signature ability drawn from your willpower. Your facility with Hatsu depends on your native Nen category, with off-category techniques suffering efficiency loss and strain.

Enhancement.name: Enhancement
Enhancement.description: The Enhancer's gift: infusing your aura into your body and objects to amplify their natural properties. Enhancement hardens your muscles, sharpens your reflexes, and strengthens whatever you touch. This is the most direct and efficient path of Nen, turning the body itself into a weapon of devastation.

Transmutation.name: Transmutation
Transmutation.description: The art of changing your aura's fundamental qualities to mimic or create new properties. Transmutation allows a Nen user to reshape their aura into something wholly different: fire, electricity, liquid, or abstract forces. A master of Transmutation can replicate the effects of external phenomena entirely through aura manipulation.

Conjuration.name: Conjuration
Conjuration.description: The power to materialize permanent or semi-permanent objects from pure aura. Conjuration requires immense mental discipline and memorization of the object's structure. A skilled Conjurer can summon weapons, tools, or artifacts that exist as long as their aura sustains them. Breaking a conjured item or dispelling it wastes the aura instantly.

Emission.name: Emission
Emission.description: The technique of projecting and controlling your aura away from your body. Emission allows you to hurl aura blasts, create distance attacks, and maintain aura in the world independently. Masters of Emission strike from afar with lethal precision, their aura obeying their will even as it separates from their flesh.

Manipulation.name: Manipulation
Manipulation.description: The ability to control and command objects or beings with your aura once it has touched them. Manipulation transforms your willpower into invisible strings that obey your consciousness. A skilled Manipulator can animate puppets, restrain enemies, or seize control of the battlefield through sheer force of intellect.

Specialization.name: Specialization
Specialization.description: The most enigmatic category of Nen: unique powers that defy the other five principles and operate by their own mysterious rules. Specialists transcend the normal hexagon of Nen and are governed by conditions, vows, and personal limitations that unlock abilities beyond normal understanding. A Specialist's power is as unpredictable as it is potent.

Martial Arts.name: Martial Arts
Martial Arts.description: Disciplined training in unarmed combat, striking, and physical technique. Martial Arts grants mastery over your body as a weapon, teaching you how to channel your strength through proper form and striking patterns. A skilled martial artist can fell opponents with their bare hands; combined with Nen enhancement, they become unstoppable forces.

Weapon Mastery.name: Weapon Mastery
Weapon Mastery.description: Proficiency with swords, axes, spears, and other martial implements. Weapon Mastery teaches you how to handle any blade or blunt instrument with speed and precision, extending your striking range and damage. A master of weapons turns their tool into an extension of their intent.

Assassination Techniques.name: Assassination Techniques
Assassination Techniques.description: Specialized training in lethal strikes, vital targeting, and disabling wounds. Assassination Techniques grant you knowledge of weak points in anatomy and the precision to strike them with deadly intent. You can incapacitate or eliminate targets quickly and quietly, turning combat into surgical execution.

Stealth.name: Stealth
Stealth.description: The art of moving unseen and unheard through any environment. Stealth teaches you how to control your footfalls, manage shadows and sightlines, and blend seamlessly into surroundings. A skilled practitioner can walk through crowded areas unnoticed or traverse enemy territory unseen.

Acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
Acrobatics.description: Mastery of movement, tumbling, and physical control through the air and over obstacles. Acrobatics grants you balance, coordination, and the ability to perform impossible feats of movement. You can scale walls, flip over hazards, and dodge incoming attacks with breathtaking grace.

Perception.name: Perception
Perception.description: Keen awareness of your surroundings and heightened sensitivity to detail. Perception allows you to notice hidden clues, track movement, and sense danger before it arrives. A skilled observer can read a room in seconds and extract meaning from the smallest tells.

Tracking.name: Tracking
Tracking.description: The skill of following trails, reading signs, and pursuing targets across any terrain. Tracking teaches you to interpret footprints, scents, disturbances in vegetation, and behavioral patterns. A master tracker can follow prey across deserts, forests, and cities alike.

Survival.name: Survival
Survival.description: Knowledge of wilderness navigation, shelter building, foraging, and enduring harsh conditions. Survival grants you the ability to sustain yourself in remote or dangerous environments through resourcefulness and toughness. You can thrive where others would perish.

First Aid.name: First Aid
First Aid.description: Medical knowledge of wound treatment, poison remediation, and emergency care. First Aid allows you to stabilize dying allies, restore health to the injured, and counter common afflictions. A skilled healer can snatch victory from the jaws of death.

Tactics.name: Tactics
Tactics.description: Strategic thinking, battle analysis, and combat planning that exploits enemy weaknesses. Tactics grants you the ability to read battles, predict opponent moves, and coordinate group efforts. A skilled tactician can win against superior numbers through clever positioning and timing.

Negotiation.name: Negotiation
Negotiation.description: Mastery of persuasion, compromise, and finding mutual benefit in dialogue. Negotiation allows you to broker deals, defuse tensions, and win concessions through words alone. A skilled negotiator can extract value from any conversation.

Intimidation.name: Intimidation
Intimidation.description: The art of projecting threat, dominance, and killing intent to compel obedience through fear. Intimidation grants you the ability to cow opponents into submission without violence. A master of intimidation can break wills through presence alone.

Deception.name: Deception
Deception.description: Mastery of lies, misdirection, and social manipulation. Deception allows you to craft believable falsehoods, read what others want to hear, and exploit trust for advantage. A skilled deceiver can run complex cons and turn enemies against one another.

Gambling.name: Gambling
Gambling.description: Expertise in games of chance, probability calculation, and reading opponents at cards and dice. Gambling teaches you probability theory, tells, and bluffing technique. A skilled gambler can win fortunes through intellect or lose everything through hubris.

Engineering.name: Engineering
Engineering.description: Knowledge of mechanics, construction, trap design, and invention. Engineering allows you to build structures, repair broken equipment, and create traps that exploit physics and ingenuity. A skilled engineer can turn simple materials into complex mechanisms of utility or destruction.

Nen-Unawakened.name: Nen-Unawakened
Nen-Unawakened.description: Your aura nodes remain sealed. You cannot access Nen in any form, and your aura pool stays dormant near zero. This state marks those unaware of Nen's existence, common before Hunter training or awakening. Your potential lies dormant, waiting for the catalyst that will open your inner gates.
Nen-Unawakened.quirk: Aura nodes are closed and sealed. The character cannot use any Nen ability, skill, or technique—Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu, all are beyond reach. Aura bar remains near zero. A narrative trigger (forced aura awakening, guided Ten initiation, or violent Nen exposure) can swap this trait for Nen Initiate in play.

Nen Initiate.name: Nen Initiate
Nen Initiate.description: Your aura nodes have been opened; you have learned the foundational technique of Ten. You can now maintain a steady aura state and hold basic Nen energy, though advanced applications remain beyond your reach. This is the threshold where the invisible world reveals itself.
Nen Initiate.quirk: Aura +30, Ten skill +2. You can hold Ten (the default meditative aura state). You are newly baptized in Nen and vulnerable to advanced practitioners, but the door has opened.

Nen Practitioner.name: Nen Practitioner
Nen Practitioner.description: You have mastered the foundational Nen techniques and are combat-capable. You can hold Ten reliably, apply Ren for amplified output, and channel basic Hatsu. You are a trained Nen user—not yet elite, but formidable in the eyes of the untrained.
Nen Practitioner.quirk: Aura +60, Ten +4, Ren +3, Hatsu +2. You can execute basic Nen combat and maintain sustained aura applications. Ren drains aura per turn in prolonged use; Hatsu abilities draw 10–20% per activation.

Nen Adept.name: Nen Adept
Nen Adept.description: You have refined your Nen to professional mastery. Your aura is vast, your control exquisite, and advanced applications like Gyo and Shu respond to your will. You are among the world's elite—a hunter of legendary standing capable of feats the average person cannot fathom.
Nen Adept.quirk: Aura +100, Ten +6, Ren +5, Hatsu +4, Zetsu +3. You can execute sophisticated aura techniques: Gyo (aura sight), Shu (object coating), In (concealment), and Ken (full defensive guard). One advanced-application ability is unlocked at character creation (chosen from Tier A: Gyo, Shu, In, Ken, Ko, or Ryu).

Nen Master.name: Nen Master
Nen Master.description: You stand among the world's apex—a living legend whose aura is nearly bottomless and whose command of Nen transcends mortal limitation. You wield advanced applications as easily as breathing and can shape reality itself through your Hatsu. Few walk this earth; fewer still reach this pinnacle.
Nen Master.quirk: Aura +150, Ten +8, Ren +7, Hatsu +6, Zetsu +5. You command all Tier A applications flawlessly: Gyo, Shu, In, Ken, Ko, Ryu, and En (aura field). Two advanced-application abilities are unlocked at character creation. Your Hatsu is legendary; your limitations are self-imposed.

Enhancer.name: Enhancer
Enhancer.description: Your Water Divination showed the water overflowing—the sign of an Enhancer. You possess raw physical prowess and the ability to amplify yourself and objects beyond their normal limits. Your Nen flows easily into your body and surroundings, making you the strongest combatant on any field. The hexagon rule governs your reach: your enhancement is full-strength in itself and adjacent categories (Transmutation, Emission), strong in distant categories (Conjuration, Manipulation), and nearly impossible in Specialization.
Enhancer.quirk: Enhancement +4 (native), Transmutation +3, Emission +3, Conjuration +2, Manipulation +2, Specialization +0. Your Nen specializes in amplification of self and objects. Transmutation and Emission are within reach; Conjuration and Manipulation are harder; Specialization techniques are nearly impossible to perform and require enormous effort. The hexagon dictates your efficiency: opposite-category Hatsu (e.g., a Conjurer's trap) suffers visible strain if you attempt it.

Transmuter.name: Transmuter
Transmuter.description: Your Water Divination showed the taste changing—a Transmuter's sign. You can alter the properties of your aura and objects, reshaping Nen into new forms and functions. Your techniques flow with creativity and deception; you bend the rules of reality itself. Adjacent categories (Enhancement, Conjuration) yield readily to your will; distant ones (Emission, Specialization) require great effort; opposite-category Nen (Manipulation) resists your touch severely.
Transmuter.quirk: Transmutation +4 (native), Enhancement +3, Conjuration +3, Emission +2, Specialization +1, Manipulation +1. Your Nen transforms and reshapes. Enhancement and Conjuration come naturally; Emission and Specialization are taxing; Manipulation is hostile to your nature and nearly impossible without exhaustion. The hexagon enforces this: you are a creative liar, and your Nen reflects that flexibility—except where it refuses.

Conjurer.name: Conjurer
Conjurer.description: Your Water Divination revealed impurities—the mark of a Conjurer. You summon matter from nothing, creating objects and weapons that manifest your will. Your Nen is precise and analytical; you are meticulous and high-strung, crafting tools with obsessive care. Transmutation and Specialization respond to your summons; Enhancement and Manipulation are within range; Emission lies distant; you alone among categories touch Specialization easily.
Conjurer.quirk: Conjuration +4 (native), Transmutation +3, Specialization +2, Enhancement +2, Manipulation +2, Emission +1. Your Nen creates real objects from aura. Transmutation flows from your conjurations naturally; Specialization is uniquely accessible to you (forbidden to pure Enhancers/Emitters); Enhancement and Manipulation are taxing; Emission is nearly impossible. You are analytical and precise—your Nen reflects that obsessive control.

Manipulator.name: Manipulator
Manipulator.description: Your Water Divination showed the leaf moving—a Manipulator's sign. You command and control external objects and forces through pure will, bending them to your logic. Your Nen is invisible and precise; you are argumentative and cerebral, turning your opponent's own strength against them. Emission and Specialization yield to your control; Conjuration and Enhancement are manageable; Transmutation resists; you alone among categories touch Specialization easily.
Manipulator.quirk: Manipulation +4 (native), Emission +3, Specialization +2, Conjuration +2, Enhancement +2, Transmutation +1. Your Nen controls external forces and objects. Emission flows from your commands; Specialization is uniquely accessible to you (forbidden to pure Enhancers/Emitters); Conjuration and Enhancement are difficult; Transmutation is nearly impossible. You are logical and stubborn—your Nen works through pure reason and will, but cannot shapeshift.

Emitter.name: Emitter
Emitter.description: Your Water Divination showed the color changing—an Emitter's mark. You project your aura outward as waves, beams, and blasts, striking your enemies from a distance with raw power. Your Nen is aggressive and impatient; you are hot-blooded and bold, charging forward where others calculate. Enhancement and Manipulation respond readily; Transmutation and Specialization are within reach; Conjuration lies distant; you cannot easily conjure.
Emitter.quirk: Emission +4 (native), Enhancement +3, Manipulation +3, Transmutation +2, Conjuration +1, Specialization +1. Your Nen projects outward as force and energy. Enhancement and Manipulation flow naturally from your projection; Transmutation and Specialization are possible but effortful; Conjuration is nearly impossible (you cannot create lasting objects easily). You are impatient and aggressive—your Nen reflects your hot-blooded nature.

Specialist.name: Specialist
Specialist.description: Your Water Divination showed something else entirely happening—the rarest and most mysterious sign. You do not fit the hexagon. Your Nen follows no predictable pattern; you are an individualist whose power is singular and often inexplicable. All other categories are equally distant to you; you are truly alone on the wheel. Your Hatsu is unique by definition, and you alone can touch techniques forbidden to other categories.
Specialist.quirk: Specialization +4 (native), Conjuration +3, Manipulation +3, Transmutation +2, Emission +2, Enhancement +1. Your Nen breaks the hexagon rules. You alone can combine Conjuration and Manipulation freely (other categories cannot); you are equally awkward in all other categories. You are an individualist—your Nen is yours alone, following laws no one else understands. Other Nen users cannot easily predict or counter your techniques.

Undivined.name: Undivined
Undivined.description: You have not yet undergone Water Divination. Your Nen category remains unknown—even to you. Your potential is uncharted, your strength untested against the glass and water that reveals all Nen users' truths. In play, the moment you perform or witness Divination, the universe will answer.
Undivined.quirk: This character's Nen category has not been revealed. They carry no category skill modifiers. When they perform Water Divination in play (a narrative moment or a semantic trigger), a trigger swaps this trait for the appropriate category trait and narrates the divination result. Until then, they are a mystery—even to themselves.

Developing Hatsu (Enhancement).name: Developing Hatsu (Enhancement)
Developing Hatsu (Enhancement).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around enhancement and amplification. You are learning to channel your Nen into strengthening yourself, objects, or targeted forces. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Enhancement).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Enhancement—amplifying strength, durability, or external objects. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Transmutation).name: Developing Hatsu (Transmutation)
Developing Hatsu (Transmutation).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around transmutation and property-alteration. You are learning to reshape your aura into new forms and functions—changing its nature, density, or behavior. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Transmutation).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Transmutation—altering aura properties, changing material states, or transforming Nen into new shapes and functions. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Conjuration).name: Developing Hatsu (Conjuration)
Developing Hatsu (Conjuration).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around conjuration and summoning. You are learning to manifest objects from pure aura—weapons, tools, or barriers that obey your will. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Conjuration).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Conjuration—summoning objects, creating weapons, or manifesting barriers from aura. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Emission).name: Developing Hatsu (Emission)
Developing Hatsu (Emission).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around emission and projection. You are learning to channel your aura outward as waves, beams, or projectiles—striking from distance or defending at range. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Emission).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Emission—projecting aura as force and energy, attacking or defending at range. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Manipulation).name: Developing Hatsu (Manipulation)
Developing Hatsu (Manipulation).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around manipulation and control. You are learning to command external forces and objects through your will—bending them to your logic and turning them against your enemies. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Manipulation).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Manipulation—controlling external objects and forces, commanding puppets or remote effects, turning enemy strength against them. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Specialization).name: Developing Hatsu (Specialization)
Developing Hatsu (Specialization).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around specialization and the inexplicable. Your technique follows no predictable pattern—it is singular, mysterious, and uniquely yours. It may blend categories or break the hexagon's rules entirely. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Specialization).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Specialization—a Nen ability that follows no standard rules, combines categories unpredictably, or works through pure individual talent. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

No Hatsu Yet.name: No Hatsu Yet
No Hatsu Yet.description: You have not yet developed a signature Hatsu technique. Your Nen remains general and unspecialized; you rely on foundational applications and raw skill rather than a personal power. In time, with focus and growth, a unique technique may crystallize.
No Hatsu Yet.quirk: No Hatsu modifier granted. You have not yet awakened or developed a personal Hatsu technique. You rely on Ten, Ren, Zetsu, and other foundational applications. A Hatsu may emerge in play as your character grows.

Rookie Hunter Applicant.name: Rookie Hunter Applicant
Rookie Hunter Applicant.description: You are an aspirant seeking the Hunter License—untested, driven, and willing to face the Exam's trials. You carry basic survival skills and battlefield awareness, though you lack the seasoning of true experience. Your endurance and willpower have been forged through training; your perception is sharp. The path ahead will test everything you believe about yourself.
Rookie Hunter Applicant.quirk: Endurance +1, Willpower +1. Skills: Survival +2, Perception +2. You are fresh, hungry, and dangerous—not yet shaped by real danger, but ready to be.

Licensed Hunter.name: Licensed Hunter
Licensed Hunter.description: You hold the Hunter's License—a badge earned through grit, cunning, and survival. You have passed the Exam and walked into the wider world. Your willpower is steel; your intellect sharp and practiced. You read people and territories with an expert's eye. The Association recognizes you; the world watches you with respect or fear.
Licensed Hunter.quirk: Willpower +2, Intellect +1. Skills: Perception +2, Tracking +2, Negotiation +1. You are fully fledged—licensed, recognized, dangerous.

Arena Fighter.name: Arena Fighter
Arena Fighter.description: You have honed your body and instincts in the brutal honesty of combat arenas. Your strength is legendary; your endurance tested by a thousand battles. You move with acrobatic grace and strike with precision. You know the rhythm of violence—the ebb, flow, and fatal moment. Victory is your habit.
Arena Fighter.quirk: Strength +2, Endurance +1. Skills: Martial Arts +3, Acrobatics +2. You are a weapons-grade combatant trained by the arena itself.

Zoldyck-Trained Assassin.name: Zoldyck-Trained Assassin
Zoldyck-Trained Assassin.description: You have been shaped by the Zoldyck family—or trained by those who survived their methods. You are a living weapon, conditioned for stealth, precision, and lethality. Poison flows through your veins and knowledge; toxins are second nature. Your agility is supernatural; your willpower unbreakable. Death is your trade, and you are excellent at it.
Zoldyck-Trained Assassin.quirk: Agility +2, Willpower +1. Skills: Assassination Techniques +3, Stealth +3, Poison resistance built into your physiology. You are a predator—efficient, cold, and nearly unstoppable in the shadows.

Mafia Community Member.name: Mafia Community Member
Mafia Community Member.description: You come from the underworld—born into a mafia family or organization. You understand the language of power, money, and calculated cruelty. Your presence commands attention; your intellect navigates the byzantine politics of organized crime. You intimidate without words; you lie with the ease of breathing. The underworld is your domain.
Mafia Community Member.quirk: Presence +2, Intellect +1. Skills: Intimidation +2, Deception +2, Gambling +2. You are politically savvy, dangerous, and connected to power that operates in shadow.

Meteor City Survivor.name: Meteor City Survivor
Meteor City Survivor.description: You hail from Meteor City—the place that doesn't exist, where the unwanted make their homes in urban ruin. You have survived by stealth, cunning, and brutal adaptability. Your endurance is forged in hardship; your agility honed by danger. You know how to vanish and how to survive where others would perish. Officially, you were never born.
Meteor City Survivor.quirk: Endurance +1, Agility +1. Skills: Survival +3, Stealth +2. Officially, this character does not exist in any record. No birth certificate, no identity, no trail—perfect for those who need to disappear.

Hunter Association Staff.name: Hunter Association Staff
Hunter Association Staff.description: You work for the Hunter Association in an official capacity—an administrator, logistics officer, or specialist handler. You understand the Association's machinery from the inside; you navigate its bureaucracy with ease. Your intellect is sharp; your presence commanding. You treat Hunters as assets and allies. Power flows through information and organizational control.
Hunter Association Staff.quirk: Intellect +2, Presence +1. Skills: Tactics +2, First Aid +1, Negotiation +2. You are politically connected and understood the Association's true nature and scope.

Greed Island Player.name: Greed Island Player
Greed Island Player.description: You have survived on Greed Island—the legendary game where card-spells rewrite reality. You understand the economy of cards, the grammar of wishes, and the mechanics of the game's impossible physics. Your intellect is razor-sharp; your willpower unshakeable. Few who enter Greed Island escape; you did, and you carry its secrets.
Greed Island Player.quirk: Intellect +2, Willpower +1. Skills: Gambling +2, Tactics +2. You are fluent in the card-spell economy of Greed Island and its reality-warping mechanics. You think in terms of costs, conditions, and chains of wishes.

Kakin Court Retainer.name: Kakin Court Retainer
Kakin Court Retainer.description: You serve the royal court of Kakin—or did once. You are versed in courtly intrigue, diplomatic subtlety, and the manipulation of power through words and alliance. Your presence is refined; your intellect navigates the labyrinth of court politics. You understand succession, succession war, and the price of ambition. You are a player in games where nations are the stakes.
Kakin Court Retainer.quirk: Presence +2, Intellect +2. Skills: Negotiation +2, Deception +2, Tactics +1. You are politically savvy, courtly, and dangerous in ways that don't leave visible marks.

Chimera Ant.name: Chimera Ant
Chimera Ant.description: You are a humanoid Chimera Ant—a fusion of human and insect born from the Queen's appetite. You retain fragments of a devoured human's memories and personality, granting you intelligence and complexity that pure Ants lack. Your strength and agility are superhuman; your body a masterwork of predatory evolution. You carry an intrinsic aura—untrained, but potent. You are an aberration, and you know it.
Chimera Ant.quirk: Strength +2, Agility +2, Endurance +1. Skills: Martial Arts +2. You possess innate aura generation without formal Nen Training (your Nen tier is set narratively). You are inhuman—designed by nature and the Queen's choice to be superior to humans in every visceral way. Playable only in late-story arcs (Chimera Ant and beyond).

Civilian Prodigy.name: Civilian Prodigy
Civilian Prodigy.description: You are a untrained genius—a prodigy whose raw intellect or talent far exceeds the norm. The Hunter Association has not yet found you, or you have not yet sought them out. Your intellect is extraordinary; your presence magnetic. You carry one knowledge skill at expert level—mastery in some domain that sets you apart. The world does not know what you are capable of yet.
Civilian Prodigy.quirk: Intellect +2, Presence +1. One knowledge skill (Tactics, First Aid, Engineering, Gambling, Tracking, or Perception) gains +3. You are untrained but brilliant—dangerous precisely because you operate outside the Association's frameworks and expectations.

Kurta Survivor.name: Kurta Survivor
Kurta Survivor.description: You are one of the Kurta—or the last of them. Your eyes burn scarlet when emotion overwhelms you, marking you as prey to every Nen user who hunts your kind. You carry the weight of genocide; your willpower is tempered steel. When your eyes ignite, your concentration deepens, your perception sharpens, and you become something terrible—but you are also a walking bounty, a target for collectors and assassins.
Kurta Survivor.quirk: Willpower +2, Intellect +1. Skills: Perception +3. When your eyes turn scarlet (a state triggered by extreme emotion or voluntary focus), you gain a concentration bonus—your perception and aura control sharpen. But your scarlet eyes mark you as a Kurta, making you a target. Few know your tribe still has survivors.

Vow: Sworn Nemesis.name: Vow: Sworn Nemesis
Vow: Sworn Nemesis.description: You have sworn a vow of enmity against a single foe—a nemesis whose name is written into your very Nen. Your hatred amplifies your strength immeasurably against them; your techniques are devastatingly effective. But this focus is a cage: against anyone else, your enhanced abilities are nearly useless.
Vow: Sworn Nemesis.quirk: Ren +3, Hatsu +2 (stacking with other modifiers). This bonus applies ONLY against the sworn nemesis named at character creation. Against any other opponent, these bonuses are nullified—your hatred is so specific that it cannot be redirected. Breaking this vow (failing to challenge the nemesis, letting them live when you could kill them, or forgiving them) strips the trait and cripples your aura for one story chapter.

Vow: Announce the Kill.name: Vow: Announce the Kill
Vow: Announce the Kill.description: You have sworn that before unleashing a killing technique, you will announce your intent aloud. This vow binds your Nen, forcing transparency and honor. Your techniques are empowered by this binding; your Hatsu gains strength from the announcement. But the cost is tactical: you cannot ambush, cannot hide your preparations, cannot catch foes unaware.
Vow: Announce the Kill.quirk: Hatsu +2 (stacking with other modifiers). You may ONLY use your most devastating Hatsu techniques after declaring your intention aloud—the enemy hears you coming. This prevents surprise kills and assassination; it makes you predictable. Breaking this vow (attempting a killing technique without announcement) strips the trait and suppresses your aura for one story chapter.

Vow: Pacifist's Edge.name: Vow: Pacifist's Edge
Vow: Pacifist's Edge.description: You have sworn never to strike first—a binding vow that channeling your Nen into defense rather than offense. Your Ten is unyielding; your Ren a protective shield. But you surrender the first move; you can only counterattack, only defend, only respond. Patience becomes your greatest weapon.
Vow: Pacifist's Edge.quirk: Ten +3, Ren +2 (stacking with other modifiers). You may NEVER strike first in any conflict—you can only defend, parry, or counterattack. If you break this vow (throwing the first blow), the trait is stripped and your aura leaks away for one story chapter, leaving you defenseless.

Vow: Stake of Lifeblood.name: Vow: Stake of Lifeblood
Vow: Stake of Lifeblood.description: You have sworn to spend your own life force to power your Nen—a vow written in blood. Your Hatsu is monumentally amplified, burning with the vitality you feed it. But each technique visibly wounds you; your health suffers as the price of power. You are spending yourself to win.
Vow: Stake of Lifeblood.quirk: Hatsu +3, but health -10 (max health is permanently reduced). When you activate Hatsu abilities, the narrator describes visible wounds—bleeding, aging, exhaustion—as the cost. Your techniques are extraordinarily powerful, but every use draws red. Breaking this vow (refusing to pay the health cost) strips the trait and temporarily cripples your aura.

Vow: Conditional Arsenal.name: Vow: Conditional Arsenal
Vow: Conditional Arsenal.description: You have sworn that your signature technique functions only under a specific condition—a time of day, a location, an emotional state, a phase of the moon. This binding constraint channels enormous power into that moment. Your aura capacity swells with the promise; your technique is unkillable when conditions are met. Outside them, it is inert.
Vow: Conditional Arsenal.quirk: Aura +40 (stacking with other modifiers). Your signature Hatsu works ONLY under a creation-named condition (e.g., 'only at night,' 'only in water,' 'only when I am afraid,' 'only against my nemesis'). Outside that condition, your technique is completely non-functional. Breaking this vow (using the technique outside the condition) strips the trait and drains 50% of your aura immediately.

Vow: Time-Boxed Power.name: Vow: Time-Boxed Power
Vow: Time-Boxed Power.description: You have sworn that your Nen functions only within a declared window—a time limit, a situation, a specific number of hours per day. This binding amplifies your power tremendously within that window; you are a god in that moment. But outside it, you are diminished, almost ordinary.
Vow: Time-Boxed Power.quirk: Ren +3, Hatsu +3 (stacking with other modifiers), but ONLY within a creation-named window of time or situation (e.g., 'one hour at dusk,' 'during monsoon,' 'when the full moon rises'). Outside that window, these bonuses are nullified—you are an ordinary Nen user. Breaking this vow (using the powered-up form outside the window) strips the trait and temporarily suppresses your aura.

Vow: Ascetic's Discipline.name: Vow: Ascetic's Discipline
Vow: Ascetic's Discipline.description: You have sworn to live as an ascetic—refusing luxury, intoxication, and indulgence. This self-denial sharpens your willpower to a knife's edge; your mind and Nen crystallize into perfect clarity. But the price is a life of hardship: you cannot accept comfort, cannot rest in ease, cannot surrender to weakness.
Vow: Ascetic's Discipline.quirk: Willpower +1, Ten +2 (stacking with other modifiers). You must refuse luxury, intoxication (alcohol, drugs, poisons that alter perception), and indulgence (fine food, soft beds, pleasures). You live simply and harshly. Breaking this vow (accepting luxury or indulgence) strips the trait and temporarily weakens your aura.

Vow: Death Before Retreat.name: Vow: Death Before Retreat
Vow: Death Before Retreat.description: You have sworn to never flee a battle once joined—a vow of total commitment. Your resolve is absolute; your Nen burns with the promise of victory or death. But you surrender all choice of retreat; you are bound to fight until the enemy falls or you do.
Vow: Death Before Retreat.quirk: Ren +2, Hatsu +2, Ten +1 (stacking with other modifiers). Once you have entered combat with an opponent, you may NEVER flee, retreat, or abandon the fight—only surrender, die, or achieve victory. Breaking this vow (fleeing a battle you've joined) strips the trait and cripples your aura for one story chapter.

conditions.query: the player's aura nodes are forcibly opened by a hostile burst of aura forced into them, or they complete a gentle Ten initiation under a teacher, or they survive an awakening ordeal that opens their gates

effects.instruction: The world ignites. The player's own life force erupts into sudden, terrible consciousness—a roar of aura that floods through newly-opened pathways. Heat and weight saturate their body; they gasp for air as Ten settles like a second heartbeat, steady and endless. The first time they hold their own aura, exhaustion crashes down—but with it comes clarity. The invisible world reveals itself. From this moment forward, they perceive aura in the air, in living things, in the space between heartbeats. They are no longer blind. They can learn Nen. They can become something more.

conditions.query: the player performs or undergoes Water Divination and the result is that the water overflows—the glass cannot contain it, the glass shatters, the water spills everywhere uncontrolled

effects.instruction: The glass shatters. Water overflows in a torrent, unstoppable and raw—not constrained but liberated. An Enhancer. Your Nen flows outward in amplification; your power rests not in subtlety but in sheer, overwhelming force. You will strengthen yourself, amplify objects, make things raw and more than they were. The hexagon opens before you: Enhancement is your native tongue; Transmutation and Emission are sisters; Conjuration and Manipulation are distant; Specialization is a language you will never speak. Your Nen is the voice of amplification—primal, direct, unstoppable.

conditions.query: the player performs or undergoes Water Divination and the result is that the taste changes—the water becomes sweet, bitter, salty, sour, or transforms into something else entirely

effects.instruction: The taste changes on your tongue. What was water becomes something else—sweet wine, bitter herbs, salt of the sea—transformed. A Transmuter. Your Nen bends and reshapes; you are a creative liar whose Nen follows your deception. You will alter properties, reshape Nen into new forms, dance between categories with fluid grace. The hexagon opens: Transmutation is your native tongue; Enhancement and Conjuration are sisters; Emission and Specialization are taxing; Manipulation resists you fiercely. You are a shapeshifter—flexible, creative, unexpected. Reality bends when you touch it.

conditions.query: the player performs or undergoes Water Divination and the result is that impurities appear—dust, sediment, material manifests in the water where there was none before

effects.instruction: Impurities bloom in the water. Material appears—dust, particles, substance manifesting from nothingness. A Conjurer. Your Nen summons matter from the void; you create real objects that obey your will. You are analytical, precise, high-strung—obsessive in your crafting. The hexagon opens: Conjuration is your native tongue; Transmutation and Specialization are close; Enhancement and Manipulation are manageable; Emission is nearly impossible. You alone can touch Specialization as easily as other Conjurers touch Enhancement. You are an architect of reality—creating weapons, tools, and traps with meticulous care.

conditions.query: the player performs or undergoes Water Divination and the result is that the leaf (or object in the water) moves—shifts, rotates, follows an invisible current or command

effects.instruction: The leaf moves. No current pushes it; no wind stirs it—yet it drifts, obedient to invisible will. A Manipulator. Your Nen controls and commands external forces; you bend objects and enemies to your logic through pure will. You are argumentative, cerebral, logical—turning opponents' own strength against them. The hexagon opens: Manipulation is your native tongue; Emission and Specialization are close; Conjuration and Enhancement are manageable; Transmutation is nearly impossible. You alone can touch Specialization as easily as other Manipulators touch Emission. You are a strategist—invisible, precise, inexorable.

conditions.query: the player performs or undergoes Water Divination and the result is that the color changes—the water becomes red, blue, gold, black, or any hue where clear water was

effects.instruction: The color changes. Clear water becomes dyed—gold, crimson, violet—stained by your presence. An Emitter. Your Nen projects outward as waves, beams, and blasts; you strike enemies from distance with raw, aggressive force. You are hot-blooded and bold, impatient and direct. The hexagon opens: Emission is your native tongue; Enhancement and Manipulation are sisters; Transmutation and Specialization are taxing; Conjuration is nearly impossible. You cannot easily create lasting objects; your power is projection and outward force. You are a warrior—impatient, aggressive, burning with power.

conditions.query: the player performs or undergoes Water Divination and the result is something impossible—the water defies the divination entirely, behaves in an impossible way, or produces an outcome that matches no standard category

effects.instruction: Something impossible happens. The divination fails, or succeeds in an utterly unexpected way. A Specialist. You do not fit the hexagon. Your Nen follows no predictable pattern; you are an individualist whose power is singular and inexplicable. The six categories yield to you equally poorly and equally well—you are truly alone on the wheel. The hexagon opens: Specialization is your native tongue; Conjuration and Manipulation are close; Transmutation, Emission, and Enhancement are equally distant. You alone can combine Conjuration and Manipulation freely; you alone can touch techniques forbidden to other categories. You are an anomaly—your Nen is yours alone, following laws no one else understands.

The character's aura is empty. They have entered involuntary Zetsu—a state of profound defenselessness. Their Nen capabilities vanish; they cannot activate any Nen ability. Against enemies who perceive aura, they are as fragile as an untrained human. Cold spreads through their limbs. Exhaustion crashes down like a tide. Every Nen user in the area can sense their weakness; predators circle. The character is defenseless until aura recovers. The narrator should impose heavy fatigue, vulnerability, and mortal danger during this state. Describe their trembling hands, their labored breathing, the feeling of their own absence. They are hollow until the well refills.

conditions.query: the player attacks someone other than their sworn nemesis with a technique granted by the Sworn Nemesis vow, or uses the vow's power against anyone except the named nemesis

effects.instruction: The vow shatters. The player's hatred—carefully honed into a needle of absolute focus on their nemesis—tears itself out of their aura in a visible backlash. The Nen world's absolute law manifests: a broken oath collects its debt instantly and without mercy. Aura explodes outward in a wave of agony; the player feels their power hemorrhaging away, their reserves draining to a trickle. What was sworn devotion becomes savage pain. The nemesis-granted strength was a cage; breaking it leaves the character wounded, diminished, and vulnerable. The narrator describes the backlash viscerally: the character screaming as their own aura tears free, the world turning black at the edges, the sudden, crushing weight of their power turning against them.

conditions.query: the player attempts or executes a killing technique without announcing their intention aloud first, or hides their preparations for a lethal Hatsu

effects.instruction: The vow shatters. The binding oath that empowered your killing techniques tears loose from your aura in a catastrophic backlash. Nen's absolute law is unforgiving: a broken vow exacts its price instantly and visibly. Your aura drains away in agony; what was enhanced power becomes hemorrhaging weakness. The character feels the binding chain—the promise of declaration that made their techniques mighty—snap and recoil, tearing through their spirit like shrapnel. Describe the backlash viscerally: blood streaming from the character's eyes, their body convulsing, the world spinning, their aura leaking away like spilled water. They are diminished, wounded, and vulnerable.

conditions.query: the player strikes first in a conflict, throws the first blow, or initiates violence before being attacked—breaking the vow to never strike first

effects.instruction: The vow shatters. The binding oath that channeled your Nen into defense—making Ten a fortress and Ren a shield—tears loose in a visible, catastrophic backlash. Nen's absolute law exacts its price: a broken vow collects its debt instantly. Your aura drains away in pure agony. The character's defensive power, their only refuge, turns against them; Ten collapses, Ren scatters, and they stand defenseless. Describe the backlash in visceral detail: the character's shield cracking apart, their body flooded with cold, their aura leaking away like water through shattered glass. They are vulnerable, wounded, and exposed.

conditions.query: the player refuses to pay the health cost when activating Hatsu abilities, or evades the visible wounds and aging required by the vow

effects.instruction: The vow shatters. The binding oath written in blood—the contract that exchanged your lifeblood for power—tears loose from your aura in a violent, immediate backlash. Nen's absolute law does not tolerate broken debts: the aura you fed with your life force turns against you in wrath. Your power drains away as aura hemorrhages. The character feels their own life force rebelling; every cell screams as the connection severs. Describe the backlash viscerally: blood pouring from the character's mouth and eyes, their body shriveling as the life-debt comes due, their aura scattering like ashes. They are weakened, wounded, and vulnerable—the price extracted, after all, but not the price they chose.

effects.instruction: The vow shatters. The binding condition that channeled your Nen into monstrous power—but only when specific circumstances aligned—tears loose in a backlash of pure rage. Nen's absolute law exacts its price: a broken oath collects its debt instantly and without mercy. Your aura drains away in agony. The character feels the conditional binding snap and recoil; the framework that made their technique unkillable dissolves into pain. Describe the backlash in visceral detail: the character's aura exploding outward uncontrolled, their technique misfiring and tearing into them, their power draining away in an uncontrolled flood. They are vulnerable, wounded, and diminished.

effects.instruction: The vow shatters. The binding oath that compressed godlike power into a narrow window—making them a force of nature within that moment—tears loose in a catastrophic backlash. Nen's absolute law is merciless: a broken vow collects its debt instantly and violently. Your aura drains away in pure agony. The character feels the time-locked binding snap; the framework that held their power collapses. Describe the backlash in visceral detail: the character's aura scattering like sparks, their power hemorrhaging away uncontrolled, their body convulsing as the temporal binding tears free. They are wounded, diminished, and vulnerable—the god-moment shattered, the power gone.

Nen's absolute law does not tolerate the weak: a broken vow exacts its price instantly and without mercy. Your aura drains away in pure agony. The character feels their carefully-honed discipline collapse; the clarity they won through hardship scatters like smoke. Describe the backlash in visceral detail: the character's body wracked with pain as indulgence wars with aura, their power fragmenting, their clarity dissolving into fog. They are weakened, vulnerable, and diminished—comfort became poison.
